blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce a gradient-based head attribution strategy where the Token-level Max-Margin loss is backpropagated to the attention maps. This framework enables a large-scale causal analysis of attention heads, making it suitable for LLMs. We evaluate our method on the task of disambiguation in Context-aware Machine Translation, where we analyze 50 phenomena across 4 models and 4 language directions. We empirically show the alignment of our method with the effects of increasing the attention scores of token-to-token relations on three models and two language directions, ensuring the robustness of our method. Our analysis reveals the presence of the "general-purpose" attention heads that improve the model’s performance when attending to different relations. We find that the average attention a head assigns to a relation does not necessarily relate to the model’s performance, which suggests that the models developed redundancies during training in terms of the head functions.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了基于梯度的头部归属策略,即Token级的Max-Margin损失被反射到关注图中. 这一框架能够对注意力头进行大规模因果分析,使其适合法学硕士。 我们评估了我们在背景感知机器翻译中的分解任务的方法,我们分析了4种模型和4种语言方向的50种现象。 我们经验性地表明,我们的方法与增加三个模型和两个语言方向上的象征性对接关系的关注分数的效果是一致的,确保了我们的方法的稳健性. 我们的分析揭示了“通用”关注头目的存在,这些头目在处理不同关系时改善了模型的表现。 我们发现,主管给关系分配的平均注意力不一定与模型的性能有关,这表明模型在培训时在头部功能方面形成了冗余。

blocks.en: In Context-Aware Machine Translation (MT), providing the system with surrounding sentences allows it to maintain document-level coherence and resolve linguistic ambiguities ( Agrawal et al., 2018 ; Bawden et al., 2018 ; Voita et al., 2019b ) . While previous works often focused on specialized architectures ( Tu et al., 2017 ; Bawden et al., 2018 ; Miculicich et al., 2018 ; Maruf et al., 2019 ; Huo et al., 2020 ; Zheng et al., 2021 ) or the encoder-decoder Transformer models, often referred to as the single-encoder architecture ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Sun et al., 2022 ; Majumde et al., 2022 ; Gete et al., 2023 ; Post and Junczys-Dowmunt, 2023 ; Mohammed and Niculae, 2024 ) , the research focus has recently shifted toward the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Wang et al., 2023b ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Alves et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , which utilize the decoder-only Transformer architecture to process context autoregressively. Despite the performance of these models ( Pang et al., 2025 ) , their size poses a challenge to analyzing their internal behavior.
blocks.zh: 在上下文-Aware机器翻译(MT)中,为系统提供周围的句子,使其能够保持文件层次的一致性并解决语言上的模糊性(Agrawal等人,2018年;Bawden等人,2018年;Voita等人,2019年b). 虽然以往的作品往往侧重于专业建筑(Tu等人,2017年;Bawden等人,2018年;Miculicich等人,2018年;Maruf等人,2019年;Huo等人,2020年;Zheng等人,2021年)或编码器-编码器变换器模型,常被称为单编码器建筑(Vaswani等人,2017年;Sun等人,2022年;Majumde等人,2022年;Gete等人,2023年;Post and Junczys-Dowmunt,2023年;Mohammed and Niculae,2024年),但研究重点最近转向使用大语言模型(LLLMs)(Wang等人,2023b;Wang等人,2024年;Alves等人,2024年;Cui等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024年)。 尽管这些模型的性能(Pang等人,2025年),其大小对分析其内部行为构成挑战.

blocks.en: Research on interpretability has demonstrated that specific attention heads within Transformers often learn to perform distinct, human-interpretable functions ( Vig and Belinkov, 2019 ; Clark et al., 2019 ; Voita et al., 2019c ; Olsson et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . Techniques such as Activation Patching have been widely used to identify which components are causally responsible for specific model behaviors ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Related to this, Modifying Heads ( Mąka et al., 2025a ) , which is a technique where attention scores for specific linguistic relations are artificially shifted, has emerged as a tool to measure the causal importance of head-relation pairs. By forcing a head to attend to a specific contextual cue (e.g., a pronoun-antecedent relation), we can observe the impact on model performance as indicated by the accuracy in contrastive evaluations ( Müller et al., 2018 ; Lopes et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于可解释性的研究表明,变形人内部的特定关注头经常学会履行独特的,人可解释的职能(Vig和Belinkov,2019年;Clark等人,2019年;Voita等人,2019年c;Olsson等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年). 诸如激活补丁等技术被广泛用于确定哪些组件对具体的模型行为负有因果关系(Wang等人,2023a); 张等,2025). 与此相关的是修改头(Máka et al.,2025a),这是一种人为地转移特定语言关系的注意力分数的技术,它已成为衡量头与头关系对子的因果关系的工具. 通过强迫头目关注特定背景提示(如代词-保证关系),我们可以观察到对比评价的准确性所显示的对模型性能的影响(Müller等人,2018年;Lopes等人,2020年).

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the computational cost of these causal interventions is significant because in modern LLMs with dozens of layers, there exist thousands of potential head-relation pairs. Consequently, performing a full sweep of modifications to identify functionally important components is prohibitively expensive. For instance, evaluating the EuroLLM 1.7B model ( Martins et al., 2025 ) across all relevant relations requires thousands of individual evaluation runs. This limits our ability to scale the intervention-based studies to larger models or to include more language directions and linguistic phenomena.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些因果干预措施的计算成本是巨大的,因为在具有数十层的现代法学硕士中,有数千对潜在的头与头的关系。 因此,为了确定功能上重要的组件而进行全面的修改费用高昂。 例如,在所有相关关系中评价欧洲LLM 1.7B模型(Martins等人,2025年),需要数千次单独评价。 这限制了我们把基于干预的研究扩大到更大的模型或包括更多的语言方向和语言现象的能力。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose an efficient framework that automates the head-relation attribution, which extends the scalability of the interpretability studies for LLMs. Our method approximates the effects of head modification using gradient attribution. By backpropagating a loss into the attention maps (not to model’s parameters or inputs to the network), we can identify promising heads without the need to exhaustively evaluate each head-relation pair (see Figure 1 for an overview).
We introduce and evaluate the Token-level Max-Margin loss ℒ T ​ M ​ M \mathcal{L}_{TMM} , designed to align the gradient signal with the change in the accuracy of the contrastive evaluation after attention intervention.
This allows us to select only the most promising (top- k k ) head-relation pairs for modification, significantly reducing the computational cost while maintaining the robustness of our analysis.
We conduct a large-scale evaluation by analyzing 50 contextual phenomena across four language directions in four open-weights instruction-tuned LLMs: EuroLLM 1.7B ( Martins et al., 2025 ) and 9B ( Ramos et al., 2026 ) , Qwen 2.5 1.5B ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Qwen et al., 2025 ) , and Gemma 3 1B ( Team et al., 2025 ) .
We study the following contextual phenomena: Gender, Formality, Auxiliary, and Inflection (see Appendix A for more details).
While we concentrate our evaluation on the task of Context-aware MT, the technique can, in principle, be applied to any task where a plausible token-to-token relation can be defined, which we test on the task of Indirect Object Identification ( Wang et al., 2023a ) .

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We propose a gradient-attribution framework to automatically identify salient head-relation pairs responsible for context utilization. • We demonstrate that focusing on top- k k heads identified via gradients preserves the accuracy of the analysis while reducing computational requirements by more than 96%. • We perform a large-scale analysis of four LLMs across four language directions. We confirm the presence of attention heads in LLMs that not only attend to linguistically relevant token-to-token relations but also improve the performance when the attention is increased. • We discover attention heads that exhibit multi-functional behavior (attending to multiple specific relations), and we link this overlap with the generalizability of the models, which could open possibilities for improved transfer. • We demonstrate a dissociation between the average attention score and the model’s performance, suggesting that LLMs develop functional redundancies.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Historically, many dedicated architectures have been proposed for Context-aware MT ( Miculicich et al., 2018 ; Voita et al., 2019b ; Voita et al., 2019a ; Bao et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Feng et al., 2022 ; Bulatov et al., 2022 ) including the popular multi-encoder in which a separate encoder is responsible for processing the context sentences ( Jean et al., 2017 ; Miculicich et al., 2018 ; Maruf et al., 2019 ; Huo et al., 2020 ; Zheng et al., 2021 ) , but the standard Transformer model with the sentences being concatenated, known as single-encoder ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Tiedemann and Scherrer, 2017 ; Ma et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2020 ) , exhibited high performance despite its relative simplicity ( Majumde et al., 2022 ; Sun et al., 2022 ; Gete et al., 2023 ; Post and Junczys-Dowmunt, 2023 ) . Because of model scaling and pretraining on massive-scale datasets, the decoder-only LLMs have achieved state-of-the-art results in Context-aware MT ( Wang et al., 2023b ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Alves et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2024 ; Kocmi et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Pang et al., 2025 ) . However, the scale of the models presents a challenge for analyzing how the internal mechanisms in the models relate to their performance on the end task.
blocks.zh: 从历史上看,许多专门的建筑都为背景感知MT(Miculicich等人,2018年;Voita等人,2019年b;Voita等人,2019年a;Bao等人,2021年;Chen等人,2022年;Feng等人,2022年;Bulatov等人,2022年),包括一个大众多编码器,其中单独的编码器负责处理上下文判决(Jean等人,2017年;Miculicich等人,2018年);Maruf等人,2019年;Huo等人,2020年;Zheng等人,2021年),但标准变形器模型,其判决正在合并,被称为单编码器(Vaswani等人,2017年;Tiedemann和Sherrer,2017年;Ma等人,2020年;Zhang等人,2020年),尽管相对简单(Maumde等人,2022年;Get,2022年;Get等人,2022年; 由于大规模数据集的模型缩放和预训,只有解码器的LLMs在Contexe-aware MT(Wang等人,2023b); Wang等人,2024年;Alves等人,2024年;Cui等人,2024年;Kocmi等人,2024年;Wu等人,2024年;Pang等人,2025年). 然而,模型的规模对分析模型中的内部机制如何与其在最终任务方面的绩效相联系提出了挑战。

blocks.en: Research has shown that the general-purpose translation metrics, such as BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) and COMET ( Rei et al., 2020 ) , do not measure how well the models use context ( Hardmeier, 2012 ; Wong and Kit, 2012 ) . This is because often only a few tokens require context in a given sentence (e.g., pronouns in a gendered language), and the standard metrics are insensitive to such small mistakes. To mitigate this issue, both contrastive ( Müller et al., 2018 ; Bawden et al., 2018 ; Voita et al., 2019b ; Lopes et al., 2020 ) and generative ( Wicks and Post, 2023 ) evaluation datasets have been introduced.
blocks.zh: 研究表明,通用翻译计量标准,如BLEU(Papineni等人,2002年)和COMET(Rei等人,2020年),没有衡量模型使用上下文的程度(Hardmeier,2012年;Wong和Kit,2012年)。 这是因为常常只有少数的符号需要在特定句子中上下文(例如性别化语言中的代词),标准度量法对这样的小错误不敏感. 为缓解这一问题,采用了对比性(Müller等人,2018年;Bawden等人,2018年;Voita等人,2019年b;Lopes等人,2020年)和遗传性(Wicks and Post,2023年)评价数据集。

blocks.en: Numerous methods aimed at explaining Natural Language Processing models have been proposed ( Bau et al., 2018 ; Toneva and Wehbe, 2019 ; Ferrando et al., 2022 ; Langedijk et al., 2024 ; Meng et al., 2024 ) . While using raw attention scores as explanations is a topic of debate ( Jain and Wallace, 2019 ; Wiegreffe and Pinter, 2019 ) , attention remains the primary mechanism in the Transformer model enabling contextualization. Therefore, understanding its influence on the model’s behavior is an active area of research ( Wiegreffe and Pinter, 2019 ; Abnar and Zuidema, 2020 ; Kobayashi et al., 2020 ; Kobayashi et al., 2021 ; Bogoychev, 2021 ; Gheini et al., 2021 ; Mohebbi et al., 2023 ) . Several works suggest that some heads exhibit specific functions ( Clark et al., 2019 ; Voita et al., 2019c ; Olsson et al., 2022 ; Todd et al., 2024 ) often linked to linguistically plausible relations ( Vig and Belinkov, 2019 ; Tenney et al., 2019 ; Jo and Myaeng, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 提出了许多旨在解释自然语言处理模型的方法(Bau等人,2018年;Toneva和Wehbe,2019年;Ferrando等人,2022年;Langedijk等人,2024年;Meng等人,2024年)。 虽然将原始关注分数作为解释是争论的话题(Jain and Wallace, 2019; Wiegreffe and Pinter, 2019),但关注仍然是变形金刚模型中促成背景化的主要机制. 因此,了解其对模型行为的影响是一个活跃的研究领域(Wiegreffe和Pinter,2019;Abnar和Zuidema,2020;Kobayashi等人,2020;Kobayashi等人,2021;Bogoychev,2021;Gheini等人,2021;Mohebbi等人,2023). 有几部作品认为,一些头部显示出特定的功能(Clark等人,2019年;Voita等人,2019年c;Olsson等人,2022年;Todd等人,2024年)往往与语言上可信的关系联系在一起. (Vig and Belinkov, 2019; Tenney等人, 2019; Jo and Myaeng, 2020).

blocks.en:
Similar to our approach, many works on interpretability employed gradients to explain the decisions of the models ( Bach et al., 2015 ; Shrikumar et al., 2017 ; Sundararajan et al., 2017 ; Yin and Neubig, 2022 ) with attention heads being the focus of some of them ( Selvaraju et al., 2017 ; Chefer et al., 2021 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Jo et al., 2025 ) .
The ultimate goal of those works was to explain the models by identifying the parts of the inputs that influence the model’s behavior (local explanations). Conversely, our work concentrates on identifying parts of the model itself (i.e., attention heads) that are influencing the final prediction, known as global explanation ( Danilevsky et al., 2020 ; Madsen et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
与我们的做法类似,许多关于可解释性的工作都使用梯度来解释模型的决定(Bach等人,2015年;Shrikumar等人,2017年;Sundararajan等人,2017年;Yin和Neubig,2022年),关注点是其中一些模型的重点(Selvaraju等人,2017年;Ceper等人,2021年;Song等人,2024年;Jo等人,2025年)。
这些作品的最终目标是通过确定影响模型行为的投入部分(局部解释)来解释模型. 相反,我们的工作集中在确定模型本身(即注意头)中影响最终预测的部分,称为全球解释(Danilevsky等人,2020年;Madsen等人,2022年)。

blocks.en:
Attention Patching ( Wang et al., 2023a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) and Modifying Heads ( Mąka et al., 2025a ) are the intervention-based interpretability techniques that aim to identify meaningful functions of attention heads.
While Attention Patching replaces the attention map for a head while processing the contrastive input with the saved attention map of the correct input,
the Modifying Heads technique changes the attention to match the specified value C C for a specific token-to-token relation, maintaining the distribution of attention for other tokens.
It necessitates the specification of relations of interest, but allows for measuring the potentially positive effect of increased attention and enables the targeted fine-tuning of attention heads ( Mąka et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh:
注意补丁(Wang等人,2023a); Zhang等人,2025年)和"修改头"(Máka等人,2025年a)是基于干预的可解释性技术,旨在识别注意力头的有意义的功能.
注意补丁代替一个头的注意地图,同时处理对比输入和保存的注意地图的正确输入,
修改标头技术改变注意度,以匹配指定值C对特定符对符关系,保持其他符的注意力分布.
它需要具体说明利益关系,但可以衡量更多关注的潜在积极影响,并能够有针对性地调整关注负责人(Máka等人,2025a)。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3 Background
blocks.zh: 3 背景情况

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the existing concepts upon which our work builds. We start by formulating the attention mechanism in the Transformer model ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . Next, we present the attention intervention from the Modifying Heads method ( Mąka et al., 2025a ) . Lastly, we describe the contrastive evaluation in Context-aware MT ( Müller et al., 2018 ; Lopes et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们阐述我们工作所依据的现有概念。 我们首先在变形金刚模型(Vaswani等人, 2017年)中制定关注机制。 接下来,我们介绍修改头法(Máka等人,2025年a)的关注发言。 最后,我们描述了对背景认识的MT的对比性评价(Müller等人,2018年;Lopes等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Modifying Heads
blocks.zh: 3.2 修改头

blocks.en:
Modifying Heads ( Mąka et al., 2025a ) adjusts the attention scores corresponding to a specified token-to-token relation 𝒳 → 𝒴 \mathcal{X}\rightarrow\mathcal{Y} . It makes the total attention score of each token in 𝒳 \mathcal{X} given to 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} tokens equal a desired value C C while not changing the pre-softmax attention scores of all other tokens.
It is formulated as follows: H ~ i , j l , h = log ⁡ ( C | 𝒴 | ​ ( 1 − C ) ​ ∑ k ∈ Y ∖ 𝒴 exp ⁡ ( H i , k l , h ) ) \displaystyle\tilde{H}^{l,h}_{i,j}=\log\biggl(\frac{C}{|\mathcal{Y}|(1-C)}\sum_{k\in Y\setminus\mathcal{Y}}\exp\left(H^{l,h}_{i,k}\right)\biggr) (3) ∀ i ∈ 𝒳 , j ∈ 𝒴 , \displaystyle\forall i\in\mathcal{X},j\in\mathcal{Y}, where H ~ \tilde{H} represents the updated pre-softmax attention scores, H H are the original pre-softmax scores, k ∈ Y ∖ 𝒴 k\in Y\setminus\mathcal{Y} are the attended tokens not present in the subset of interest 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} . Mąka et al. (2025a) modified the heads to different values of C C for relations from ambiguous words to context cues and observed the changes in the accuracy of the models in contrastive evaluation. Intuitively, the method reveals how the model reacts to the changes in the function of one of its components. There are three notions of a head’s function: (1) the head is attending a relation, which can be measured by the average attention score; (2) the head attending a relation is necessary for the end task, measured by the drop of performance when the head is modified to C = 0.01 C=0.01 ; (3) the head attending a relation is beneficial to the task, indicated by the increase in the performance on the end task when modified to C = 0.99 C=0.99 . In our work, we focus on the effects of Modifying Heads to C = 0.99 C=0.99 , as it can lead to real-world improvements in the models through the targeted fine-tuning Mąka et al. (2025a) .

blocks.en: 3.3 Contrastive Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 矛盾评价

blocks.en: Contrastive evaluation assesses whether the model effectively uses the contextual information and is based on the contrastive datasets. It presents the model with the source sentence, source and target contexts, and several versions of the target sentence with only a single word being different in each of them. The examples are chosen to make the correct version dependent on the context. The model assigns the probability to each version, which is calculated from the model’s outputs with the whole sequence (including the target sentence) as input. If the right version is assigned the highest probability, the model is said to be correct. The final score is the accuracy A A of the model over the whole dataset.
blocks.zh: 对比性评价评估该模型是否有效利用了背景信息,并以对比性数据集为基础. 它提出了模型,其中包含源句,源句和目标上下文,以及目标句的若干版本,每个版本中只有一个单词不同. 选择实例是为了使正确的版本取决于上下文. 模型为每个版本指定概率,概率从模型的输出中以整个序列(包括目标句子)作为输入计算. 如果正确的版本被指定了最高的概率,据说模型是正确的. 最后的得分是整个数据集的模型的精度A.

blocks.en: In our study, we use two contrastive datasets: ContraPro ( Müller et al., 2018 ) and Large Contrastive Pronoun Testset (LCPT; Lopes et al., 2020 ), which target pronoun disambiguation in English-to-German and English-to-French, respectively. To expand the analysis to different language phenomena, we adapt the ctxPro dataset ( Wicks and Post, 2023 ) to contrastive evaluation. The original version is used for generative evaluation, meaning that the model generates the translation, and the script checks whether it contains the expected phrase. We generate the contrastive examples by replacing the expected word in the gold translation with a word sampled from all expected words for a particular linguistic phenomenon. Because this simple method does not ensure that the replacement word is morphologically plausible, we set the number of contrastive examples to maintain the difficulty of the test. We provide more details about the process in Appendix A .

We adapt the notation of the relations from Mąka et al. (2025a) but extend the number of relations to include the relation tokens as the input to the network. blocks.en: While gradient-attribution methods have seen successes ( Sundararajan et al., 2017 ; Yin and Neubig, 2022 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Jo et al., 2025 ) , they have been criticized for their unreliability as explanations ( Wang et al., 2020 ) . In this section, we try to answer the question of why our method with Token-level Max-Margin loss ℒ T ​ M ​ M \mathcal{L}_{TMM} showed moderate to strong correlations with the accuracy difference Δ ​ A \Delta A and effectively ranked top head-relation pairs.

While the relation for the accumulated gradients (shown in Figure 4(a) ) is monotonic (to the granularity of the tested values), the gradients for the individual examples (depicted in Figure 4(b) ) are not only non-monotonic but also change sign. This finding highlights that gradient-attribution methods are hindered by the non-monotonicity of the underlying function, and the accumulation of the gradients can mitigate this issue ( Sundararajan et al., 2017 ) .

blocks.en: In this section, we analyze the models on a wide range of language directions and phenomena. Specifically, we include translating from English to German, French, Polish, and Russian, and the following phenomena: Gender (we use ContraPro and LCPT for English-to-German and English-to-French, respectively, and ctxPro Gender for English-to-Polish and English-to-Russian), Auxiliary, Formality, and Inflection (the last one available only for English-to-Polish and English-to-Russian). This amounts to 50 scenarios across four models and four language directions.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们分析各种语言方向和现象的模式。 具体地说,我们包括从英语翻译成德语、法语、波兰语和俄语,以及以下现象:性别(我们分别使用ContraPro和LCPT的英语对德语和英语对法语,以及ctxPro Gender的英语对波兰语和英语对俄语),辅音、形式和flection(最后一个只有英语对波兰语和英语对俄语)。 这相当于四个模型和四个语言方向的50种设想。

blocks.en: We apply our gradient-based framework by first backpropagating the Token-level Max-Margin loss ℒ T ​ M ​ M \mathcal{L}_{TMM} and selecting top- k k head-relation pairs in terms of aggregated gradient. Motivated by the rank of top head-relation pairs (see Figure 3 ), we set the number of heads evaluated by Modifying Heads to be equal to 3% of all head-relation pairs. Note that, due to the lack of specified context cues in the ctxPro dataset for Formality and Inflection, we cannot define all of the relations explored previously for those phenomena, as only the contextually dependent phrases are identified. This shortens the list of relations to: T P → S P T_{P}\rightarrow S_{P} and T P → S P + 1 T_{P}\rightarrow S_{P+1} , effectively reducing the number of head-relation pairs. For those phenomena, we still maintain the same computational budget for modifying top heads as for other phenomena. Therefore, we modify 15% of top head-relation pairs for Formality and Inflection. While gradients align well with the change in the accuracy Δ ​ A \Delta A , we saw that some heads can attend a relation but the model will not improve the performance when those heads are modified (e.g., 14-9 T P → S P T_{P}\rightarrow S_{P} in Figure 5 ). To analyze those heads, we modify 0.3% of head-relation pairs with the highest average attention scores. Because the evaluation of the EuroLLM 9B model on ContraPro was done for a limited set of relations, we additionally evaluate the top 3% head-relation pairs according to our method and analyze the combined results. We omit evaluating Formality and Inflection for this model due to the low statistical significance of the results for those phenomena on the smaller models.

blocks.en:
Our work confirms that heads appear to have specific functions by attending to a specific relation or improving the model’s performance when modified to C = 0.99 C=0.99 . While this is in line with previous research ( Clark et al., 2019 ; Voita et al., 2019c ; Olsson et al., 2022 ; Mąka et al., 2025a ) , our analysis reveals that the heads can attend to or benefit from modifying multiple relations. This generalization of capability can manifest in several forms spanning different types of relations: • Same relation but the target token on the input and output - for example, the heads 19-8 in EuroLLM 1.7B and 24-11 in Qwen 2.5 1.5B improve accuracy on the ContraPro dataset when modified to attend both the T P → T C T_{P}\rightarrow T_{C} and T P → T C + 1 T_{P}\rightarrow T_{C+1} relations. This corroborates the finding that the identity of the input token is maintained through the layers ( Brunner et al., 2020 ) , but such heads are not widespread. • Same relation and phenomenon but different language directions - the examples include head-relation pairs 14-9 T P → S P T_{P}\rightarrow S_{P} in EuroLLM 1.7B, 32-3 T P → T C + 1 T_{P}\rightarrow T_{C+1} in EuroLLM 9B, 16-2 T P → T C + 1 T_{P}\rightarrow T_{C+1} in Gemma 3 1B for ContraPro, LCPT, and Gender (both for English-to-Polish and English-to-Russian), and 20-13 T P → T C + 1 T_{P}\rightarrow T_{C+1} and 22-13 T P → T C T_{P}\rightarrow T_{C} for Auxiliary (all language directions) in EuroLLM 1.7B, among others. • Same relation but different language direction and phenomenon - for example, head-relation pairs 16-3 T P → S P + 1 T_{P}\rightarrow S_{P+1} for Formality and Inflection (high attention but not accuracy difference) in EuroLLM 1.7B, and 12-2 T P → S P + 1 T_{P}\rightarrow S_{P+1} in Gemma 3 1B exhibit this behavior. • Different relation, language direction, and phenomenon - most notably, heads 18-6,
and 18-14 in EuroLLM 1.7B, 25-4 in EuroLLM 9B, 20-2 in Qwen 2.5 1.5B, and 18-3 in Gemma 3 1B. The existence of those "general-purpose" attention heads suggests that the updates to the residual stream coming from those heads share some component, as the information they encode can improve the model’s performance on several tasks. We leave the detailed exploration of this finding for future work.

blocks.zh: 6.3 与通用性的联系

blocks.en: Motivated by the overlap of some heads between phenomena and language directions, we quantified the extent of shared head-relation pairs between each phenomena. We selected the head-relation pairs that exhibit an increase in accuracy Δ ​ A \Delta A greater than half of the maximum Δ ​ A \Delta A for each phenomenon and language direction separately. We applied the same criterion to average attention scores. The results can be seen in Figure 7 .

blocks.en: We observed a large overlap for Auxiliary between language directions for both the average attention scores and accuracy increases Δ ​ A \Delta A . For Gender (including ContraPro and LCPT), the overlap is high based on the average attention, and substantially lower based on the accuracy increase Δ ​ A \Delta A . Similar trends can be seen for Formality and Inflection, although the results in terms of accuracy increase Δ ​ A \Delta A are not statistically significant. We argue that the overlap based on the accuracy increase Δ ​ A \Delta A better explains the transfer during training between phenomena observed by Mąka et al. (2025b) , where it was higher for Auxiliary, very limited inside other phenomena, and not present at all between different phenomena. Intuitively, positive changes to accuracy when modified indicate the potential of certain heads to improve the model’s performance during training. Whether these heads actually learn to attend more to the relations during training and how this relates to the improvements in other phenomena is left for future work.

blocks.en:
The Modifying Heads technique artificially intervenes in the model’s forward pass. In this section, we examine how this intervention, when learned by the model, impacts the general translation performance and the contrastive accuracy.
To this end, we replicate the Head Tuning technique from Mąka et al. (2025a) , where the parameters of Q Q and K K projections of the selected heads are tuned to attend more to the specified relation. We tune the heads of the EuroLLM 1.7B model with a context size of 1 using the ctxPro English-to-German Gender dataset. Next, we measure ContraPro accuracy and BLEU and COMET on the 10000 randomly selected English-to-German examples from the OpenSubtitles 2018 ( Lison et al., 2018 ) dataset. The details are presented in Appendix D .

“修改头”技术人为地干预了模型的前传。 在本节中,我们研究这种干预,如果从模型中得知,如何影响一般翻译业绩和对比性准确性。
为此,我们从Máka等人(2025年a)复制了头部图宁技术,其中对选定头部的QQ和KK预测的参数进行了调整,以更多地关注指定的关系。 我们使用ctxPro英语对德语的性别数据集来调谐EuroLLM1.7B模型的首字母,上下文尺寸为1. 接下来,我们用来自2018年OpenSubtitles(Lison等人,2018年)数据集的1000个随机选取的英德例来测量ContraPro精度和BLEU和COMET. 详情见附录D。

blocks.en: 7 Indirect Object Identification Task
blocks.zh: 7 间接物体识别 任务

blocks.en: To test the generalizability of our method, we apply it to the task of Indirect Object Identification (IOI) ( Wang et al., 2023a ) , where an expression such as "Then, [B] and [A] went to the house. [B] gave a drink to" (where "[A]" and "[B]" are names) should be completed with "[A]". We used EuroLLM 1.7B Instruct, but the task is very simple, and even this small model achieves near-perfect accuracy of 99.9%. Therefore, we follow the original paper and measure the difference in logits between the correct and incorrect name. The tested model exhibits a logit difference of 5.26 5.26 . The details are presented in Appendix E .

blocks.en: 8 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a gradient-based head attribution method based on the contrastive loss backpropagated to the attention maps. We exhaustively evaluate the method on the established tasks of disambiguating context-dependent phrases in Context-aware Machine Translation. We show that our method correlates with the Modifying Heads technique, allowing us a substantial expansion of the analysis scope, by reducing the computational cost by more than 96%. In total, we analyze 50 phenomena across 4 models and 4 language directions. We demonstrate the potential generalizability of our method by applying it to the task of Indirect Object Identification.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一种基于梯度的头部归属方法,其基础是反射到注意力图的对比性损失. 我们详尽地评价了在了解背景的机器翻译中将依赖上下文的短语分解的既定任务的方法。 我们显示,我们的方法与 " 修改头 " 技术相关,使我们能够大幅扩大分析范围,将计算成本降低96%以上。 总之,我们分析出跨越4个模型和4个语言方向的50种现象. 我们通过将这种方法应用于间接物体识别任务,证明了我们的方法的潜在普遍性。

blocks.en: We identify that some heads are "general-purpose", improving the model’s performance when attending to different relations. This behavior generalizes across different language directions and in some cases phenomena, and we link this overlap in the heads’ apparent functions to the transfer effect between language directions and phenomena during training. Finally, our findings suggest that the models develop redundancies during training in terms of the head functions. In future work, we will expand the analysis to other contextual tasks and larger models.
blocks.zh: 我们发现一些头目是"通用的",在关注不同关系时改善了模型的表现. 这种行为概括了不同语言方向和在某些情况下现象,我们把头部明显功能的这种重叠与培训期间语言方向和现象之间的转移效应联系起来。 最后,我们的调查结果表明,这些模式在培训期间在领导职能方面形成了冗余。 在今后的工作中,我们将扩大分析范围,使之包括其他相关任务和更大的模式。

blocks.en: Appendix A Generating Contrastive Dataset
blocks.zh: 附录A 生成对照数据集

blocks.en:
In this section, we describe the creation process of the contrastive version of the ctxPro datasets ( Wicks and Post, 2023 ) .
Below, we list the contextually-dependent linguistic phenomena that we included in our study: • Gender (anaphoric pronouns) - translating a pronoun from a non-gendered language to a language with gendered nouns. • Formality (anaphoric pronouns) - translating into a language with different second-person pronouns distinguishing intimate from formal relationships between speakers from a language lacking this distinction. • Auxiliary (verb phrase ellipsis) - translating into a language that require the head of the verb phrase from a language that allows for only the modal or auxiliary to be used. • Inflection (verb phrase ellipsis) - translating into a language with noun morphology dependent on the grammatical role from a language where this is not the case.

blocks.en: We started with the evaluation datasets released with the paper under https://github.com/rewicks/ctxpro/tree/main/paper/jsons . For all phenomena and language directions, we replaced the contextually dependent phrase in the target segment with phrases sampled from the list of phrases from the other examples (excluding the same phrases), respecting the capitalization of the original phrase. We sampled with respect to the distribution of occurrences, as our tests showed that this increased the difficulty of the created datasets. We chose the number of contrastive target sentences for each example to balance the difficulty (based on the EuroLLM 1.7B model) and the computational cost of evaluation. We set this number to 4 for gender, 5 for formality and inflection, and 8 for auxiliary. In the experiments, we used ContraPro ( Müller et al., 2018 ) and LCPT ( Lopes et al., 2020 ) instead of the generated contrastive versions of ctxPro for Gender in English-to-German and English-to-French, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在https://github.com/rewicks/ctxpro/tree/main/paper/jsons下发布评价数据集。 对于所有现象和语言方向,我们用从其他例子的短语列表中抽取的短语(不包括同一短语)来取代目标部分中上下文依赖的短语,尊重原始短语的资本化. 我们抽样研究了事故的分布情况,因为我们的测试表明,这增加了所建立数据集的难度。 我们为每个例子选择了对比性目标句数,以平衡难度(基于EuroLLM 1.7B模型)和评价的计算成本. 我们规定这个数字是性别的4个,形式和功能的5个,辅助的8个。 在实验中,我们分别使用ContraPro(Müller等人,2018年)和LCPT(Lopes等人,2020年),而不是在英语对德语和英语对法语中生成的ctxPro for Gender的对比版本.

blocks.en: Appendix D Details of Head Tuning

blocks.en: We perform Head Tuning using the ctxPro English-to-German Gender dataset containing 13640 annotated examples. We freeze all parameters of the model apart from the Q and K projections of the selected layer, and calculate the MSE loss between the actual attention scores of the selected head and the attention scores after applying the intervention. Following Mąka et al. (2025a) , we use the baseline model to calculate the modified attention scores (we load the base model twice: the first one for fine-tuning, the second one for calculating the target attention scores). We used a learning rate of 2e-5 with linear scheduling and no warmup steps, 10 epochs, and a batch size of 4 with 8 gradient accumulation steps. The training took less than one hour on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 24GB.

blocks.en: In the task of Indirect Object Identification (IOI) ( Wang et al., 2023a ) the model has to complete expression in the form "Then, [B] and [A] went to the house. [B] gave a drink to ", where "[A]" and "[B]" are names, and the model should prefer "[A]" over "[B]". In the actual examples, both name placeholders are replaced by popular English names. In the original paper, the names are chosen to be encoded as a single token by the tested model. In case of our model (EuroLLM 1.7B Instruct), the list contained multi-token names, therefore, we removed them when generating the examples. The above example is in the form BABA (corresponding to the order of names). In our experiments we include both BABA and ABBA templates. We generated 10000 unique examples using the code from the paper’s repository 9 9 9 https://github.com/redwoodresearch/Easy-Transformer . Due to the simplicity of the task and the near-perfect accuracy exhibited by the tested model, we measure the difference in the logits of the two names from the examples.
blocks.zh: 在"间接物体识别(IOI)"(Wang et al., 2023a)的任务中,模型必须完成"然后,[B]和[A]到屋里去"的表达. [B]给",在"[A]"和"[B]"是名字的地方,模型应该更喜欢"[A]"而不是"[B]". 在实际例子中,两个名字的占位符都被流行的英语名字所取代. 在原始论文中,名字被选为被测试模型作为单一的代号. 就我们的模型(EurolM 1.7B Instructionct)而言,该清单包含多键名称,因此我们在生成实例时将其删除。 以上例子以BABA(对应姓名顺序)的形式出现. 我们的实验包括BABA和ABBA模板。 我们用文件存放处的代码创造了一万个独特的例子。 由于任务简单,且测试模型所显示的精确度接近完美,我们从实例中衡量两个名字的对数差异。
